outline: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

Analyze your own muscle strength and physical performance, identify areas for improvement, and design a training plan.

flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: The 16+2 flexible learning outcomes account for 10%.

assessment:
I. Attendance and Participation Grade: 60%
**A total of 12 classes. Each class is worth a maximum of 5 points based on participation level.**
Active participation and full completion of required tasks: 5 points
Active participation with incomplete task completion: 4 points
Limited participation with full task completion: 3 points
Limited participation and incomplete task completion: 2 points
Absence without completion of make-up requirements: 0 points
Absence with approved make-up assignment completed: 3 points

II. Physical Fitness Test: 15%
Choose one test.

III. Final Exam Activities: 15%
Four final exams in total. 5 points for each completed exam.

III.  flexible learning: 10%
